checked_files.used_for: cookbook self-mapping with all-chain and base-level alignment

findings: -P retains all chains; -p and -N have no effect with it.
-p controls secondary-to-primary chain score ratio and can prevent DP extension of weaker secondary chains.
-N is a secondary-alignment limit, not a hard global cap on every PAF row/primary/supplementary alignment.
Changing exact chain admission is a scientific approximation; original coarse search and full target contexts are kept in this isolated pilot.
